canonical.claimed_static_limit: Not solved and not claimed. The static, spherically symmetric, weak-field sector reduces at leading order to GR sourced by M_Pl^2, plus a scalar-mediated correction whose range and strength depend on the specific a1(\phi,X), V(\phi) chosen from the bounded grammar below. Whether this correction is Yukawa-like, power-law, or negligible, and what PPN \gamma, \beta values it implies, is unknown until coefficients are fixed and the vacuum/Newtonian asymptotics gate is actually run. No numeric agreement with any observed force law, static profile, or object class is asserted here.
evasion_rationale: Matter is coupled to exactly one metric with no \phi-dependence at all, so there is no gradient-of-a-field channel through which matter feels a state built from \partial\phi; this directly targets the repeated universal_minimal_matter_coupling rejections tied to a gradient-based coupling mechanism.

There is no auxiliary field standing in for a 'measured' or effective acceleration/state that matter responds to instead of g_{\mu\nu}; S_m is a function of g_{\mu\nu} and \Psi_matter only, closing off the measured-state coupling channel that was repeatedly rejected.

No current, vector flux, or flux-conservation law is introduced as a matter-coupling channel; the only new field is a scalar entering solely through the gravitational sector, not the matter sector, closing off the flux channel.

No interpolating or saturating function of a local kinematic quantity is used to switch matter's coupling on or off; the coupling to g_{\mu\nu} is the same algebraic form everywhere, closing off the saturation channel.

The higher-derivative scalar terms are accompanied, in the action itself, by named algebraic degeneracy conditions (quadratic DHOST class Ia) rather than being left as a generic higher-derivative Lagrangian whose degeneracy is asserted informally after the fact; this is meant to give the kinetic-rank/degeneracy gate an explicit, checkable structure instead of a bare claim.
No object-specific or environment-specific parameter appears anywhere in S_m or in a1..a4, V; all coefficients are universal functions of \phi and X only.
canonical.expected_dof:
3 propagating degrees of freedom total: 2 tensor (graviton) polarizations from g_{\mu
u} plus 1 scalar from \phi. The degeneracy conditions built into the action are intended to remove the Ostrogradski ghost mode that generically appears from the (\Box\phi)^2 and \phi_{\mu
u}\phi^{\mu
u} terms; this must still be confirmed by an explicit ADM/Hamiltonian constraint analysis at the kinetic-rank gate, which has not been performed here.
falsification_tests: Solve the static, spherically symmetric weak-field equations for a fixed choice of coefficients drawn from the bounded grammar and extract PPN \gamma, \beta; reject that coefficient choice if it is inconsistent with existing Solar-System bounds on |\gamma-1| and |\beta-1|.

Perform a covariant composition-independence (Eotvos-type) test of free fall for two matter species with different internal binding energy, using only the single S_m[g_{\mu\nu};\Psi_matter] coupling; reject if any coefficient choice predicts a nonzero differential acceleration inconsistent with existing torsion-balance bounds.

Compute the principal symbol / characteristic surfaces of the full field equations for the tensor and scalar sectors; reject any coefficient choice that yields superluminal or complex characteristics (fails hyperbolicity).

Perform an ADM constraint analysis of the quadratic-DHOST sector to count physical degrees of freedom directly; reject the proposal (or that branch of the degeneracy conditions) if it yields more than 3 propagating modes.

On an FLRW background, compute the tensor perturbation speed c_T from the action and compare it to c using an independent gravitational-wave propagation-speed bound; reject if c_T deviates from c beyond the bound's stated precision.

family_comparisons.expression:
S = S_grav + S_phi + S_m, with

S_grav = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g) (M_Pl^2/2) F(phi) R

S_phi = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g) [ P(phi,X) + Q(phi,X) Box(phi) + A1(phi,X) ( phi_{mu nu} phi^{mu nu} - (Box phi)^2 ) ]

S_m = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g_tilde) L_m[ g_tilde_{mu nu}, Psi_m ],
  g_tilde_{mu nu} = Omega(phi,X) g_{mu nu} + Gamma(phi,X) phi_mu phi_nu

where phi_mu = grad_mu phi, X = g^{mu nu} phi_mu phi_nu, phi_{mu nu} = grad_mu grad_nu phi, Box phi = g^{mu nu} phi_{mu nu}. F, P, Q, A1, Omega, Gamma are free functions restricted to the bounded_grammar below (same six functions for every matter species -- no per-species or per-object parameters enter g_tilde). The A2 term of the general class-Ia DHOST Lagrangian is fixed identically to -A1 by construction (folded into the single written combination), and A3=A4=A5=0 by grammar exclusion (not generated by the basis), restricting to the minimal degenerate quadratic subclass.
